Mending, Swift Sneak, Stasis Freeze & instant Reroll

Path 2 [Grand Library]: %s+ Wooden Shelves roll Epiphanies every 10 min.

Cleanse
Cleanse, Step-Down & Curse Purge
Free wipe, 1-tier step-down, targeted strip & vanilla curse purge
Open the teal Cleanse tab to modify enchanted gear or books cleanly:
Disenchant All (Free): wipes non-curses, refunds XP & yields Cleansing Grit.
Step-Down (-1 Tier): lowers 1 level + XP refund; 1->0 book gives Depleted Tome.
Targeted Strip: removes 1 chosen trait while keeping all other traits intact.
Curse Purge: Golden Apple + Lapis, Echo Shard + Lapis, or 1x Arcane Crystal.
